  • Method Details

    • render

      String render(Class<?> type, Object object)

      Converts the specified java object to a string.

      The object to be converted must be of the converter-associated java type.

      The string generated by this method is intended to be read by humans, and there is no need for it to have enough information to restore the original object.

      Parameters:
      type - type of the object to be converted to a string
      object - object to be converted to a string
      Returns:
      the specified object as a java string

    • render

      Converts the specified java object to a string.

      The object to be converted must be of the converter-associated java type.

      The string generated by this method is intended to be read by humans, and there is no need for it to have enough information to restore the original object.

      Parameters:

      object - object to be converted to a string
      format - a string to be used to format the specified object
      Returns:
      the specified object as a java string

    • toJsonText

      static String toJsonText(Object object) throws ConversionException
      Serializes the specified java object on JSON notation

      The specified object will be serialized as described on the specified java type associated Converter.

      The string generated by this method is intended to be read by humans, and there is no need for it to have enough information to restore the original object.

      Parameters:
      object - the java object to be serialized
      Returns:
      the specified java object serialized using JSON notation
      Throws:
      ConversionException - if the specified object can't be serialized on JSON notation
      See Also:

    • toJsonText

      default <T> void toJsonText(Deque<Object> stack, JsonWriter writer, Class<T> type, T object) throws ConversionException
      Serializes the specified object on JSON notation.

      The string generated by this method is intended to be read by humans, and there is no need for it to have enough information to restore the original object.

      Type Parameters:
      T - type of the java object to be serialized
      Parameters:
      stack - tracks objects currently being serialized to prevent infinite recursion
      writer - JsonWriter responsible for serializing the object
      type - type of the java object to be serialized
      object - object to be serialized
      Throws:
      ConversionException - if the specified object cannot be serialized on JSON notation
